name: Gabby Giffords
desc: American politician and gun control activist (born 1970)
summary: Gabrielle Dee Giffords (born June 8, 1970) is an American retired politician and activist. She served as a member of the United States House of Representatives representing Arizona's 8th congressional district from January 2007 until January 2012, when she resigned due to a severe brain injury suffered during an assassination attempt. A member of the Democratic Party, she was the third woman in Arizona's history to be elected to the U.S. Congress.
